title: Tool identity table
description: Each tool an adk-tools image runs, named by its content. The image build writes it once, as /opt/adk-tools/tool-identity.json, with nix/tool_identity.py. Byte form: one line of compact JSON, object keys sorted, no whitespace, separators ',' and ':', followed by exactly one newline; the same bytes as Python's json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) plus '\n', UTF-8. A reader that keeps a copy keeps these bytes unedited and names the copy by their sha256. The table holds no image ID: an image ID is a digest over the image's layers, this file included, so the build cannot write it. A reader pairs the table's digest with the image ID the launcher gives (run.sh sets ADK_TOOLS_IMAGE, sha256:<64 hex>, in every container it starts); when that variable is absent or not an image ID it records no image ID and never derives one. What identifies a tool is its digests and its version; a path is where it sat in that image, recorded as provenance. Every digest is a sha256 in 64 lowercase hex digits.

closure_sha256.description: The closure digest over every Nix store path any tool needs, each counted once: the sha256 of the UTF-8 text made of one line '<NAR sha256>\n' per path, the lines sorted. Store paths do not enter it, only contents.

tools.description: One entry per tool, sorted by name, each name once.

items.description: One tool. A pinned Nix tool (from image-store or host-store) has path, nar_sha256 and closure_sha256, and null version, binary and binary_sha256. A tool no pin names (from image), outside Nix or a single store binary the Nix lane's shell names, has version, binary and binary_sha256, and null closure_sha256; its path and nar_sha256 are both set or both null.

name.description: The tool's name, stable across images. A pinned Nix tool is named after its staging.pin pin, NIX_<X>_OUTPATH, as <x> in lower case with '-' for '_', which is also the adk-tools flake's package name (openroad, librelane, sg13g2-pdk, cosim-python, mixsim-ngspice, ...).

from.description: image-store: a Nix store path the image carries in its own /nix/store. host-store: a Nix store path the image names in a label and run.sh mounts from the host's store at run time; its digests are the build host's, so a run on another host has the same tool only if that host's narHash for the path is the same. image: a tool no pin names, keyed by its version and its binary's bytes: one installed outside Nix in the run's own file system (the image's, or the host's in the Nix lane), or a single store binary the Nix lane's shell names, such as its git.

path.description: Provenance, not identity. A pinned Nix tool: its store path. A tool no pin names: the directory that holds it and its own libraries, or null when it has none of its own.

nar_sha256.description: The sha256 of path's NAR serialisation, as Nix serialises a path (a regular file is executable when its owner may execute it; directory entries in byte order of their names). For a store path it equals the narHash nix path-info reports, decoded from base64. Null exactly when path is null.

closure_sha256.description: A pinned Nix tool's closure digest: as the top-level closure_sha256, over the store path and every path it requires. Null for a tool no pin names.

version.description: A tool no pin names: the version it reports, as it prints it (kicad-cli version, klayout -v, python3 -V, git --version). One that prints none carries 'commit <commit>', the commit it was built from. A single script of adk-tools itself, with no release of its own, carries 'sha256 <digest>', the sha256 of its bytes. One run from a staged checkout carries 'commit <HEAD> tracked <digest>': the commit the checkout's HEAD names, and the sha256 of the canonical JSON (keys sorted, separators ',' and ':', ASCII, no newline) of the sorted [path, sha256] rows of every file its .git/index tracks, each by its bytes on disk. Null for a pinned Nix tool, whose store path names its version.

binary.description: Provenance, not identity. A tool no pin names: the file its command runs, symlinks resolved. Null for a pinned Nix tool.

binary_sha256.description: The sha256 of binary's bytes. Null for a pinned Nix tool.
